env_allowlist.HOME: runner home used only to address the hash-verified .elan/bin/lake launcher

network_enforcement: The checker runs a fresh-output Lean replay inside bubblewrap with --unshare-net, a read-only host root, and only a disposable temporary directory writable. It performs no update, build, clone, fetch, checkout, or network operation. The existing pinned warm .lake is reused read-only, so this recipe is deliberately nonrelease evidence rather than a cold empty-cache reproduction.
scope_boundary: Current-base negative release reconciliation plus a network-isolated trust-zero replay of the defective frozen proposition, its local vacuity body, and the no-Proof differential reconstruction. A passing recipe supports only the blocked release decision; it does not establish source identity, an accepted CKN proof, AUDIT-Z, THEOREM-Z, master acceptance, cold offline reproduction, independent runners, or a deterministic release bundle.
